markets.price_type: Day-ahead settlement point price for the ERCOT Hub Average 345 kV Hub (HB_HUBAVG / ERCOT 345). Energy plus congestion via averaged hub shift factors. No separate marginal-loss component in the ERCOT LMP.
markets.geographic_scope: ERCOT-published hub defined from the North, South, Houston, and West 345 kV hubs. Panhandle and Lower Rio Grande Valley hubs are excluded.
markets.official_source_name: DAM Settlement Point Prices (EMIL NP4-190-CD, report type 12331)
markets.source_granularity: Hourly settlement point price, hour-ending, one row per settlement point per hour
markets.timezone: Central Prevailing Time (hour ending). API metadata quoted by ERCOT includes a DSTFlag. Not re-queried with credentials in this pass.
markets.daily_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of published HB_HUBAVG prices for the operating day. Use the published series; do not recompute the mean of HB_NORTH, HB_SOUTH, HB_HOUSTON, and HB_WEST. Include every valid hour (23 or 25 when DST applies).
markets.historical_start: 2010-11-29 (EMIL first run). Public API activation date and whether every year back to 2010 is queryable were not confirmed.
markets.publication_lag: Posted once per Day-Ahead Market run, for the next operating day. Exact clock time not verified.
open_questions: Confirm NP4-190-CD archive depth inside the authenticated Public API versus the seven-year historic-file rule.
Confirm DSTFlag behavior on a 23-hour and a 25-hour operating day.
Confirm whether corrected DAM prices replace the posted file in place.

markets.price_type: Day-ahead total LMP (energy + congestion + marginal loss) at the RTO aggregate pricing node
markets.geographic_scope: PJM RTO aggregate, pricing node id 1. Feed displays have shown both the names PJM-RTO and PJM for this id.
markets.daily_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of total_lmp_da for pnode_id 1 where row_is_current is true. Do not substitute system_energy_price_da.
markets.historical_start: 2000-06-01 (feed definition First Available). Retained indefinitely; archived after 731 days with stricter query rules.
markets.publication_lag: Daily between 12:00 p.m. and 1:30 p.m. Time zone of that window is not stated on the feed definition.
open_questions: Confirm in a PJM manual that pnode 1 total LMP is the load-distribution-weighted RTO price rather than a fixed-weight aggregate.
Resolve the PJM-RTO versus PJM display name for pnode id 1.
Execute Associate Membership or another redistribution licence before any public derived series.
File-verify a 23-hour and a 25-hour Eastern Prevailing Time day.

markets.price_type: Day-ahead Marginal Energy Cost (MCE / LMP_ENE_PRC). Uniform system energy component. Excludes congestion, losses, and the marginal greenhouse-gas component.
markets.geographic_scope: CAISO balancing authority area, at the distributed reference bus. Not NP15, SP15, or ZP26.
markets.official_source_name: OASIS Locational Marginal Prices, PRC_LMP, market_run_id DAM
markets.source_granularity: Hourly day-ahead interval, one row per node per component (LMP, MCC, MCE, MCL, MGHG)
markets.timezone: OPR_DT and OPR_HR in Pacific prevailing time, hour ending. INTERVALSTARTTIME_GMT / INTERVALENDTIME_GMT in UTC. API query window is GMT.
markets.daily_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of hourly MCE. Read MCE from one trading-hub row only after checking it matches the other CAISO trading hubs that hour. Do not average hub LMPs.
markets.historical_start: OASIS online retention is the previous 39 months. Historical OASIS downloader reaches back to 2016 for expanded pricing files and requires an AWS requester-pays account. Nodal market began 2009-04-01; full pre-2016 availability of PRC_LMP was not confirmed.
markets.publication_lag: Posted after the day-ahead market for the next trading day. Exact clock time not verified.
open_questions: Decide whether the uniform marginal greenhouse-gas component (MGHG) belongs in the benchmark. It is part of LMP and was uniform across the three trading hubs on 2026-09-23, but the tariff sentence that makes MEC system-wide does not say the same about MGHG.
File-verify a Pacific DST 23-hour and 25-hour trading day.
Legal review of website Public Records Act language versus the API terms, which reserve ownership of CAISO Data.

markets.price_type: Day-ahead ex-post marginal energy component, derived as LMP minus MCC minus MLC. The 2026 daily file does not contain an MEC column. The residual was identical across sampled nodes.
markets.geographic_scope: MISO footprint system energy price. Not Indiana Hub and not a load-weighted MISO LMP.
markets.source_granularity: Hourly, wide file, HE 1 through HE 24, values LMP, MCC, and MLC
markets.timezone: Eastern Standard Time year-round. The file states hours-ending are EST. No 23- or 25-hour days.
markets.daily_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of the 24 hourly derived MEC values. Compute MEC from a single node. Do not average the eight trading hubs.
markets.historical_start: UNKNOWN for this URL. Daily files verified for 2024-04-07 and several 2026 dates. 2013-04-01 returned 404. Day-ahead market began 2005-04-01.
markets.publication_lag: Posted after the day-ahead market. Exact clock time not verified. Settlement statements are later issued at days 7, 14, 55, and 105; whether the public CSV is replaced was not verified.
open_questions: Confirm from the current BPM-005 that the public ex-post LMP, not the ex-ante LMP, is the DA_LMP_EN used to settle day-ahead asset energy.
Confirm how far back the daily CSV and the quarterly historical zips actually go.
Obtain written permission before publishing a derived series. Website terms prohibit derivative works.

markets.price_type: Final day-ahead Hub LMP (energy + congestion + loss). The Hub price is the arithmetic average of LMPs at the nodes that constitute the Hub.
markets.geographic_scope: ISO-NE Internal Hub, location id 4000 (.H.INTERNAL_HUB). A defined set of nodes, not a load zone and not all of New England.
markets.official_source_name: ISO-NE Web Services API v1.1 final day-ahead hourly LMPs
markets.timezone: Eastern Prevailing Time. BeginDate is an ISO-8601 timestamp in the derived schema. A transition-day file was not downloaded.
markets.daily_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of hourly Hub LmpTotal. The hourly value is already the ISO's node average; do not average load zones on top of it.
markets.historical_start: ISO Express has described hourly reports as available for about the past seven years. That sentence was not re-read on an ISO Express page in this pass. Earlier history exists in retired or archived reports; the cutoff was not re-verified.
markets.publication_lag: Day-ahead results are posted as final. Exact clock time not verified. Real-time prices have a separate preliminary and final path; day-ahead uses the final resource.
open_questions: Download one authenticated JSON document and confirm LmpTotal, EnergyComponent, CongestionComponent, and LossComponent against the live payload. Those names were taken from a derived OpenAPI that cites ns0.xsd.
File-verify 23-hour and 25-hour days.
Confirm how many years of /hourlylmp/da/final history the API actually returns.
Legal review of the copyright notice before publishing Hub prices or a derived daily mean.

markets.price_type: Day-ahead system marginal price at the Reference Bus, derived from zonal LBMP components. Not a zonal LBMP.
markets.geographic_scope: NYCA reference bus. The same value at every internal zone, within rounding. Not Zone J and not a statewide load-weighted LBMP.
markets.official_source_name: MIS report P-2A, Day-Ahead Market LBMP — Zonal
markets.source_granularity: Hourly hour-beginning zonal LBMP with loss and congestion components. Eleven internal zones plus four external proxy zones.
markets.timezone: Eastern Prevailing Time, hour beginning, formatted MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM. No DST flag column.
markets.daily_aggregation: For each hour, lambda = LBMP minus Marginal Cost Losses plus Marginal Cost Congestion, taken from one internal zone. Then the arithmetic mean of those hourly lambdas. On the fall-back day, keep both rows that share the 01:00 timestamp; do not key only on the timestamp string.
markets.historical_start: 1999-11-01 monthly zip is linked from the P-2A index. The 1999 file was not opened. Recent days are individual CSVs; older days are monthly zips.
markets.publication_lag: The 25 Sep 2026 file was already listed on the index on 24 Sep 2026, so the next operating day is posted after the day-ahead market. Exact clock time not verified.
open_questions: Re-test the lambda identity on the duplicated 01:00 hour using row order, not the timestamp string. Grouping by timestamp inflated the residual on 2025-11-02.
Confirm the published congestion sign against the current eTariff equation. The PDF glyphs for plus and minus did not survive text extraction.
Legal review. The legal notice grants no licence.

markets.price_type: Day-ahead Marginal Energy Component (MEC) for the SPP balancing authority. Published column. Excludes congestion and losses.
markets.geographic_scope: SPP Integrated Marketplace east BAA (BAA=SPP once that column exists). Not SPP North Hub, not SPP South Hub, and not the SWPW western BAA.
markets.source_granularity: Hourly hour-ending settlement-location LMP with MLC, MCC, and MEC
markets.timezone: Interval is Central Prevailing Time hour-ending. GMTIntervalEnd is the unique UTC key. Fall-back repeats the local interval and is separated by GMTIntervalEnd.
markets.daily_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of hourly MEC for BAA=SPP. Before the BAA column existed, MEC on SPPNORTH_HUB matched the system MEC and can be used as the single row. Do not average SPPNORTH_HUB and SPPSOUTH_HUB LMPs. Mean the 23 or 25 hours actually published.
markets.historical_start: Portal year folders are listed from 2013. Integrated Marketplace began 2014-03-01. A 2014-03-01 file at the post-2016 By_Day path returned 404. Exact archive layout before mid-2016 was not re-mapped.
markets.publication_lag: Updated each day after day-ahead results are posted. Exact clock time not verified. A RePrice folder exists for corrected files.
open_questions: Retrieve the current Integrated Marketplace Protocols. The hub-weight formula was read in Revision 36 dated 24 Feb 2016.
Pin the date the BAA column and SWPW rows were added. Absent on 2026-03-08; present on 2026-04-12.
Written SPP authorization is required before commercial publication.
